proposed_scope: One new raised-wheel drive-only power-loss/restoration attempt. JCAN serial 207F346D5650 runs normal --receive so its controller acknowledges valid CAN frames but the runner submits no JCAN data-frame send command. After passive captures and operator arm, command right wheel +5 rpm once with left wheel zero. The operator watches only the target terminal and removes drive power immediately on POWER OFF NOW, within the existing absolute 8-second loss window. Confirm POWER_OFF, hold at least 3 seconds, restore drive power once, require a post-motion boot and first RK3588 request packed zero, observe at least 5 seconds with no restart, then remove drive power again. Require successful zero/disabled cleanup, no CAN error, no re-enable after motion, target candump plus JCAN capture, final drive power OFF, no automatic retry, persistent drive write, kernel/SDK change, or JCAN data-frame TX.
